package p

import (
	"math/rand"
	"time"
)

// Config already has its World field; Options gets one.
type Config struct {
	Timeout time.Duration
	World   *dst.World
}

type Options struct {
	Name string
}

type state struct {
	w *dst.World
}

// Server keeps its World in an embedded struct.
type Server struct {
	state
	timeout time.Duration
	done    chan struct{}
}

type metric struct {
	w    *dst.World
	last time.Time
	name string
}

// pending sets its own World.
type pending struct {
	w  *dst.World
	ch chan error
}

func (p *pending) init(w *dst.World) { p.w = w; p.ch = make(chan error, 1) }

// jitter is a -world-param function: its draw needs a World.
func jitter(d time.Duration) time.Duration {
	return d + time.Duration(rand.Int63n(int64(d)))
}

func newMetric(name string) *metric {
	return &metric{
		last: time.Now(),
		name: name,
	}
}

func startMonitor(
	name string,
	every time.Duration,
) *metric {
	m := newMetric(name)
	go report(m, jitter(every))
	return m
}

func report(m *metric, d time.Duration) { _ = m; _ = d }

// NewServer takes its World from the config.
func NewServer(conf *Config) *Server {
	// Validate the configuration.
	if conf.Timeout == 0 {
		conf.Timeout = time.Second
	}
	s := &Server{
		timeout: jitter(conf.Timeout),
		done:    make(chan struct{}),
	}
	return s
}

// Describe takes a config but needs no World: no fallback.
func Describe(conf *Config) string { return conf.Timeout.String() }

func Open(opts *Options) *metric { return startMonitor(opts.Name, time.Second) }

func (s *Server) tick() time.Duration {
	p := &pending{}
	p.init(s.w)
	_ = metric{s.w, time.Time{}, "positional"}
	return jitter(s.timeout)
}

func logEvery(d time.Duration) { time.Sleep(d) }

// run starts a -world-param function: the World argument isn't copied.
func (s *Server) run() { go logEvery(s.timeout) }
